name: LessFlux Image & Video Optimizer – WebP, AVIF, CDN & Lazy Load
author: lessflux

sections.description:
LessFlux connects your WordPress site to your LessFlux account so you can configure image and video optimization settings from wp-admin.

This plugin includes:

  • Account connection with a website API key from your LessFlux dashboard.
  • Image options (selected formats, lazy load, metadata retention, conversion to WebP/AVIF, upload-time processing).
  • Video options (selected formats, processing presets, replacement behavior).
  • Optional CDN controls and status view.
  • Bulk optimization workflows for existing media.
  • Dashboard and logs screens for operational visibility.

Target users:

  • Site owners managing media-heavy websites.
  • Developers and agencies maintaining WordPress performance workflows.
  • Teams that already use a LessFlux account and want WordPress integration.

External services

This plugin uses external services provided by LessFlux and third-party CDNs for library delivery.

  1. LessFlux API

* Service: https://api.lessflux.com/v1/
* Purpose: account validation, optimization-related operations, dashboard/plugin data exchange.
* Data sent: plugin requests include site/plugin context and authentication data (such as your LessFlux API token) needed to authorize and process requests.
* Terms: https://lessflux.com/terms-conditions/
* Privacy policy: https://lessflux.com/privacy-policy/

  1. LessFlux WordPress endpoint

* Service: https://lessflux.com/wp-json/
* Purpose: plugin integration endpoints used by LessFlux WordPress workflows.
* Data sent: request metadata required to complete plugin-related actions.

  1. Third-party frontend assets

* https://fonts.googleapis.com/ (font stylesheet, admin UI only)

  1. Bundled third-party libraries (MIT licensed, included locally)

* lazysizes v5.3.2 – https://github.com/aFarkas/lazysizes (lazy loading)
* lottie-web v5.10.2 – https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web (animations, admin UI only)
* DataTables v2.3.1 – https://datatables.net (data tables, admin UI only)
* DataTables Responsive v3.0.4 – https://datatables.net/extensions/responsive (admin UI only)
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP and click Install Now.
  3. Click Activate Plugin.
  4. Open the LessFlux menu in wp-admin.
  5. Go to your LessFlux dashboard at https://app.lessflux.com.
  6. In Dashboard > Instances, add your website and copy its Website API Key.
  7. Back in WordPress, open LessFlux > Account, paste the key, and connect.
  8. Configure image/video/CDN settings as needed in the plugin pages.
sections.faq:
Do I need a LessFlux account?

Yes. You need a LessFlux account and a Website API Key from app.lessflux.com to connect the plugin.

Where do I get the API key?

In your LessFlux dashboard, go to Dashboard > Instances, add your website, then copy the generated API key.

Does this plugin work without an API key?

No. Most plugin features depend on an authenticated LessFlux connection.

What media formats can I configure?

You can choose image and video formats from the options available in the plugin settings for your account.

Can I enable or disable lazy loading?

Yes. Lazy loading can be controlled from the Image Options section in Settings.

Does the plugin send data to external services?

Yes. It communicates with LessFlux services for authenticated optimization workflows and may load third-party frontend assets in admin pages. See the External services section.
